utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still sorting that out — do you know if they need any specific tools or just the usual donations?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just the usual donations should be fine, unless someone’s bringing a special fix. I can check who still needs tools and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please let me know if anyone needs a drill or extra boards.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. If you can help, I’d love a hand with supplies or setup around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I can help with supplies or setup around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s wonderful, Jules—thank you. I’ll keep you posted on what we still need, and we can coordinate the school-schedule side from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly small fixes—patching cracks, tightening boards, and checking lights. And yes, we still need plenty of gloves, tape, and flashlights for Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — do we have enough people to handle the drop-off at the front porch by 10, or should I adjust the plan?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We could still use a couple more hands at the front porch by 10, just in case — if you can keep the drop-off a little flexible, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll text you the list tonight—tools, tape, and a couple more volunteers are still needed for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks—send the list when you can. I’ll see if I can round up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do—thanks, Noah. I’ll send it tonight and keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep—it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m a bit late, but that’s the latest update on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik—I really appreciate you spreading the word. Just keep folks pointed to the community center on Sunday, and I’ll try to catch up with everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now—do we have enough gloves, tape, and flashlights to get the repair drive started?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check what’s on the porch and bring more if we’re short. If you want, I’ll also make a quick list of anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — please check the porch and jot down anything we’re missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep asking for helpers and point them to sorting donations and setup at the community center. Just let me know if there’s anything else you still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I can help with sorting donations and setup at the community center. Just tell me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Sam — could you come by at 10 a.m.? I’ll spread the word so others know where to pitch in, too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use more helpers. If you can point people to sorting donations and setup, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Opal—I'll point folks to sorting donations and setup. If anyone asks, tell them to come by the front porch Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send folks to the front porch Saturday morning for sorting donations and setup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’ve got enough gloves, tape, and flashlights for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I think we’re set on gloves, tape, and flashlights for now. If anything’s missing, I’ll let everyone know before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, great—just wanted to make sure we’re covered before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — cracks, boards, and lights, with donations going to Mara and Leon’s unless that changes. I’ve got the gloves and tool box ready, so just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — that’s perfect. I’ll confirm the Sunday community center drop-off details and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep me posted on the Sunday drop-off, and I’m set with the gloves and tool box.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help with that—what tools are you still looking for?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re good on most of the tools now, but they could still use a few drills, screwdrivers, and maybe a ladder. Also, the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it—I can bring a drill and a set of screwdrivers, and I’ll check on a ladder too. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact repair drive details first? I’m still waiting on the exact info before I jump in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces too, so I’m not the best source. I was hoping you’d have the latest on it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the latest yet either, so I’d rather wait for the full details before I commit. Once we know the time and what’s needed, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly small fixes—patching cracks, tightening boards, and replacing a few lights. We still need all the help we can get this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what time should I be there on Saturday, and do you want me on lights or boards?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you come around 10 a.m.? Either lights or boards would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey. I’m still on for Saturday at the front porch and could use a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks. I’m still looking for a couple more helpers, if you know anyone who can stop by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey. I’ll ask around and let people know we still need a few more helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana — I still need a couple helpers for sorting donations and setup at the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — could you remind me of the exact details first, like the time and what kind of help you need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I mainly need help sorting donations and setting up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—what do you need me to do for the repair drive, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you help me confirm the drop-off details and who’s collecting donations? I’m trying to keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help confirm the drop-off details and find out who’s collecting the donations. I’ll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s right — gloves, tape, and flashlights are covered. What I still need most is help with the small repairs and a few extra hands on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I really appreciate the extra hands for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll keep things simple and organized. If you can, just be there Sunday and I’ll point you to the small repairs that need doing first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still this Saturday on the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. We could still use a few extra gloves, tape, and flashlights if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch. Do you want me to bring any gloves, tape, or flashlights?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind on that; what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s this Saturday at my front porch, and I still need a few helpers plus the wrench set and screwdrivers. I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—this Saturday at your front porch. I can help spread the word, and I’ll see if I can bring a wrench set or screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got the gloves and box, and I’ll see you at 9.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Bo — gloves and the box are covered. I’ll check the tape and flashlights, and we’ll be set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — sounds like we’re all set for Saturday. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Mara — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the drop-off details once I’ve got everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’m still happy to help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s so kind of you, Mara — I’ll send the drop-off details soon, and once I’ve lined up the tasks, I’ll let you know where you’d be most helpful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. If you want, I can point you to who’s still taking donations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep spreading the word and send folks your way for donations and setup at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep folks posted about the Sunday drive at the community center and who’s still taking donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about it. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still waiting on the exact details too, but as soon as they’re set I’ll help out. We can check the supplies bin and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—checking the supplies bin first should help.
